summary: Every method page's tables have a Custom Colors window for choosing the font and fill of each part of the tables.
details: Open it from the right-click menu of any table on a DFM, Bornhuetter Ferguson, Cape Cod, Berquist Sherman, Bootstrap, Stochastic Consolidation, or Result Selection page.
Values, column headers, row labels, the green selected cells, and highlighted cells share one set of colours across every method page; the DFM also lists the Ratios tables' own parts.
Colours apply at once to every open page and are kept for your user; Reset all returns the theme's own colours.
